title: Independent reading: Luke 10:25–37
subtitle: Follow question, counter-question, parable, and imperative.
overview: The Good Samaritan scene moves through layered questions and a story that answers them indirectly. Track each questioner and Jesus’ counter-questions.
At the conclusion, the final imperative arises from the narrative’s answer; do not detach it from the preceding exchange.

items.grc: τίς οὖν τούτων τῶν τριῶν πλησίον δοκεῖ σοι γεγονέναι;
items.en: Which of these three seems to you to have become a neighbor?
